name: Communion Banquet: Elydna Wingstroke's scaled level and health reach the client when she turns hostile (#7187)
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, offset=4 and map 1 in DestinyWeaver.Scaling.WorldMaps. Elydna Wingstroke (161784, level 7, faction 35) is friendly, so a level-20 hunter sees her authored version; she arrives in a create block, which sent_level does not observe. The Sacred Bowl (2300513) with quest 1660016 in progress makes her walk to it, kneel and after 5 s switch to faction 14 and attack. From then on the hunter's view is level 16 (20 - 4) and the client must be sent level 16 and a maximum health of her real maximum x basehp(16)/basehp(7) = 356/137 (creature_classlevelstats class 1, expansion 0). The faction change alone sends only the faction field, so without a resend no level or maximum health reaches the client and the client keeps level 7 and the authored maximum while HEALTH is patched to the viewed scale, so the bar stays full: the reported infinite health. The wait after the scaling packet lets the login and choice refresh windows (5 s) close before the faction changes.

steps.label: the hunter's view of hostile Elydna is level 16
the client is sent the viewed level
the client is sent the viewed maximum health (356/137 of the authored one)
